help.title: Help
help.discript: Show the command list or detailed help for a selected command. Registered commands without a dedicated entry also receive automatically generated help.
help.args: `command` is a command name or alias (default: main).

test.title: Test Command
test.discript: Test commands. The bot prints out the sentence as it is.
test.args: `text` str type, you can enter all characters, including str type and spacing, and the bot outputs this part as it is (default: none).

myid.title: My User id
myid.discript: Check your discord account UID value and creation date.

credits.title: Credits
credits.discript: Thank you to those who even helped create the bot!

code.title: Special Code Input
code.discript: Command to enter a code value to receive a gift.
code.args: `test` str type, enter a code value (defualt: none).

nickname.title: Change Nickname
nickname.discript:
Change your nickname!
Names are important to all dear ones...
nickname.args: `name` str type, the name to change. Up to 16 characters are allowed!

daily.title: Daily Rewards
daily.discript: You will receive a daily reward once per day, and the cooldown will be reset to UTC+0.
daily.args: `user` accepts a numeric Discord ID, member mention, or nickname tag. Only the configured administrator can claim rewards for another user.

profile.title: User Profile
profile.discript: Displays the user profile. You can check the level, experience, nickname, profile picture, and skin you are applying.
profile.args: `user` accepts a numeric Discord ID, member mention, or nickname tag. If omitted, the command user is selected.

emblem.title: Emblem
emblem.discript: Use to view icons and required experience values for each level.
emblem.args: `level` int type, enter a level value (default value: your level).

myrank.title: My Ranking
myrank.discript: Check your level and global ranking.

ranking.title: XP Ranking
ranking.discript: You can see the ranking of users. Ranking is output based on total acquired experience.
ranking.args:
`range` option, (default: global).
`page` int type, enter a value for the page to view (default: 1).

queue.title: Community Skin Queue
queue.discript: View community skins submitted through the workshop and waiting for review.
queue.args: Search with `type:money`, `keyword:pixel`, and `page:2` (default: all skins, page 1).

workshop.title: Community Skin Workshop
workshop.discript: Upload or edit a community rank-card skin, and browse the available fonts.
workshop.args: Use `workshop` or `workshop upload` to register. Use `workshop edit t16` to edit your queued skin. Use `workshop font` to list fonts or `workshop font legacy` to render a sample.

equip.title: Equip
equip.discript: Enter the skin ID to equip the skin.
equip.args: `skin_id` int type, unique value given for each skin.

purchase.title: Purchase
purchase.discript: Enter the skin ID to purchase the skin. In addition to purchasing with money, you can also unlock skins for level achievements or the number of daily rewards you receive.
purchase.args: `skin_id` int type, unique value given for each skin.

storage.title: Skin Storage
storage.discript: View and search the available profile skin collection.
storage.args: Search with `type:money`, `keyword:pixel`, and `page:2`. The legacy `pokemon 2` format is also supported.

skin.title: Skin Storage
skin.discript: View and search the available profile skin collection.
skin.args: Search with `type:money`, `keyword:pixel`, and `page:2`. The legacy `pokemon 2` format is also supported.

preview.title: Skin Preview
preview.discript: Preview a published skin or a skin waiting in the workshop queue.
preview.args: Use a number for a published skin, or a `t` prefix for a queued skin (examples: `preview 16`, `preview t16`).

stats.title: User Statistics
stats.discript: Show your records at a glance!

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.discript:
The more you share, the happier you become...
Send money to the other person!

bday_add.title: Birthday Add Command
bday_add.discript: Register a birthday notification. The bot sends a birthday message every year at midnight based on Korean time.
bday_add.args: `user` discord member mention, target user for birthday notification. `month` int type, birthday month. `day` int type, birthday day. `channel` discord text channel, notification channel. `calendar_type` str type, enter `양력` or `음력` (default: 양력). `is_leap_month` bool type, enter true only for lunar leap month (default: false).

anniv_add.title: Anniversary Add Command
anniv_add.ctx: 기념일추가 <str: title> <int: year> <int: month> <int: day> <#channel> [str: calendar_type] [bool: is_leap_month]
anniv_add.discript: Register an anniversary notification. The bot sends an anniversary message every year at midnight based on Korean time.
anniv_add.args: `title` str type, anniversary name. If spacing is included, wrap it in quotation marks. `year` int type, original anniversary year. `month` int type, anniversary month. `day` int type, anniversary day. `channel` discord text channel, notification channel. `calendar_type` str type, enter `양력` or `음력` (default: 양력). `is_leap_month` bool type, enter true only for lunar leap month (default: false).

anniv_list.title: Anniversary List Command
anniv_list.discript: Shows the registered birthday and anniversary notification list for the current server.

anniv_del.title: Anniversary Delete Command
anniv_del.discript: Delete a registered birthday or anniversary notification by event ID.
anniv_del.args: `event_id` int type, the ID of the birthday or anniversary event to delete. You can check the event ID with the `기념일목록` command.

anniv_resend.title: Anniversary Resend Command
anniv_resend.discript: Resend today's birthday and anniversary notifications of the current server. Each notification is sent to its registered channel, no matter which channel the command is used in.

pledit.title: PLab Data Editor
pledit.ctx: pledit <user> <create | unlock | lock | first | startdate | labpoint | labpointadd> [value]
pledit.discript: Create or edit PLab data. Game completion awards tier squared LAB, a server first clear awards an additional two times tier squared LAB, and Skill Level equals the highest completed tier. Login is required.
pledit.args: Use `pledit <user> unlock <game_id>` or `lock` to change completion, `first` to replace the server first clearer, and `pledit recalc` to rebuild every user's score. `user` accepts an ID, mention, or registered nickname tag.

pl.title: Precision LAB
pl.discript: View PLab statistics, LAB-point rankings, or the PLab game list. Running `pl` without an option opens your own statistics.
pl.args: Use `pl stats [user]` for statistics, `pl ranking [page]` for the LAB ranking, or `pl games [keyword]` to browse completion status. A user may be an ID, mention, or registered nickname tag.

dice.title: Dice
dice.args:
`value` int type, enter text size (default: 99).
`non_zero` option, 0 input includes 0, 1 input does not include 0 (default: 1).
`skin` option, choose between 1, 2, and 3 (default: random).

똥몬창지수.discript: 자네 몸에서 지독한 냄새가 나는데... 혹시 똥몬창인가?
똥몬창지수.args: `user` discord.user.id type, Select the user to test. If left blank, the command user himself is specified (defualt: none).

translate.title: Translator

Also... Eunbi is good at foreign languages (๑╹ワ╹)
translate.args:

`after` language code, select the language code for translation results (defualt: none).
`text` str type, enter the text to be translated (defualt: none).

끝말잇기.title: 끝말잇기 <옵션>

number.args: Type `;number help` to see how to play.

emergency-call.title: Emergency Call
emergency-call.discript: Validate registered users through a modal, then send each user 32 direct messages after a public one-time confirmation.
emergency-call.args: Enter one or more `nickname#0001`, Discord user IDs, or mentions separated by commas or new lines, followed by the message to send. Up to 20 users can be selected. Cooldown: 14,400 seconds.
